confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, price lists, or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the steadiest; hostel and hotel rates vary most by season and location, so accommodation carries the widest range. HKD is pegged to USD, which limits currency-driven error. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct recall of bar and wine prices is weaker. The FX value comes from RBA table summaries in two search results, not from opening the F11.1 data file.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: East Asia. Dining and cafe anchors are benchmarked to other high-cost Asian city centers with similar visitor price levels; hostel and hotel anchors reflect typical small-room city-center stock. No single comparable city was copied, and no live listings or booking pages were consulted.
